home.heroTitle: Know what each machine costs and earns
home.heroLead: Your crew records inspections, repairs and rentals on the phone, even without signal. The office sees it all with photos, and the cost of each machine adds up on its own.
home.problemTitle: Today information gets lost on the way
home.problemLead: Paper, WhatsApp groups and spreadsheets lose photos and hours.
home.problem1Today: A breakdown arrives as a voice note, with no photo and no idea where the machine is.
home.problem1With: A report with photos, the location and the right machine.
home.problem2Today: Repairs and rentals end with no proof of what was done.
home.problem2With: Before and after photos and the customer's signature.
home.problem3Today: Nobody knows what each machine really costs.
home.problem3With: The cost per hour of every machine, always up to date.
home.step1Title: The crew reports from the field
home.step1Body: Photos, a checklist and the location in under 2 minutes. The office sees it as soon as the phone gets signal.
home.step2Body: Before and after photos, the parts used and the customer's signature settle any argument about what happened.
home.step3Title: You see what each machine costs
home.step3Body: Parts, labour, fuel and downtime add up per machine, so you can price rentals and services with confidence.
home.offlineBody: Everything is saved on the phone and sent on its own when there is signal. Nothing is lost on the way to the office.
home.missionBody: A machine standing still is money lost. AgroRende exists so that the people who look after machines in the field work with information, not with paper and memory. We started with maintenance and rental teams, because that is where every hour counts.
home.finalTitle: Try it with your crew this season
home.finalBody: Register the company in minutes, invite the crew by WhatsApp and use everything for 30 days.

faq.a1: You pay per month for each technician who uses the app in the field. The office uses it at no cost. See the pricing page or ask for a proposal on WhatsApp.
faq.a2: No. The company's administrator can cancel at any time in Settings → Subscription.
faq.a3: Your company does. You can take everything to a spreadsheet at any time. If you cancel, the data stays available for 90 days and is then deleted.
faq.a4: By WhatsApp and email, in Portuguese, during business hours.
faq.a5: Nothing is charged unless you agree it with us. To carry on, pick the plan with our team; everything recorded during the trial stays there.
faq.q6: Does it work with machines of any brand?
faq.a6: Yes. AgroRende does not depend on the manufacturer. You register tractors, harvesters and implements of any brand and tag each one with a QR code.
faq.q7: Does it really work without internet?
faq.a7: Yes. The app saves reports, photos, videos, voice notes, checklists and signatures on the phone and sends everything when there is signal. The crew can see what is still waiting to be sent.
faq.q8: Do I need to install anything on the computer?
faq.a8: No. The office uses AgroRende in the browser. The field crew uses the app on Android or iPhone.
faq.a9: The company invites each person by WhatsApp or email. People sign in with Google, Apple or email and password.

help.codesSummary: Got an error code from the app?

helpError.retryable: It is safe to try again.
helpError.notRetryable: Trying again without changing anything will not help; use one of the options below.
helpError.kindServer: Message sent by the AgroRende server.
helpError.kindClient: Message shown by the app or the website itself.

placeholders.emailHint: the email shown in the invite

recovery.AUTO: The app tries again on its own and shows the progress.
recovery.RETRY: Tap Try again. It is safe to repeat.
recovery.FIX: Fix the highlighted field; what you already typed is kept.
recovery.ALT: Use another way to finish the same task.
recovery.DRAFT: Save it as a draft and continue later from the same step.
recovery.RESTORE: The office can restore the archived record.
recovery.SETTINGS: Open the phone or browser settings, then come back to check again.
recovery.REAUTH: Sign in again without leaving the screen; nothing you did is lost.
recovery.UPDATE: Update the app; your local data is kept.
recovery.OFFICE: Contact your company's office from the app.
recovery.DIAG: Send diagnostics from the app so the office can see the problem.
recovery.HANDOFF: The office gets a notice and fixes it; you can keep working.
recovery.FALLBACK: The app shows the last information it has and tells you when things are back to normal.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.lead: You can delete your personal AgroRende account at any time, in the app or on the web.
deleteAccount.appSteps: Open Settings and tap Account|Tap Delete account|If items are waiting to send, tap Send now or Save a copy; the app does not delete the account while work is pending on the phone|Confirm the deletion
deleteAccount.webSteps: Sign in to AgroRende in the browser|Open the menu under your name and choose Account|Click Delete account and confirm
deleteAccount.keptBody: Your name, email, phone and photo are anonymized and Google or Apple access is revoked. Records the company must keep by law or contract, such as work orders, rentals, signatures and costs, stay with the company without your personal data.
deleteAccount.companyBody: The company admin cancels the subscription in Settings → Subscription. The data stays available for export for 90 days and is then deleted.
deleteAccount.noAccessBody: Write to {email} from the email address on the account. We confirm your identity and delete the account.
